acceptedBoundaries.name: Separate fixed data and publication code
acceptedBoundaries.evidence: Workflow checks out exact event code and fixed b4 actual-main into separate directories; script requires exact actual HEAD and clean worktree, verifies Auto/ACTIVE/source2/receipt2 raw/Git/size and snapshot paths.

acceptedBoundaries.name: Issued whole-state prerequisite
acceptedBoundaries.evidence: Unique global metadata/identity and target runtime joins; current MD/ID/runtime whole equality to exact issued receipt rows for all eleven; source/ordinal/owner status exact and current ACTIVE binding required.

acceptedBoundaries.name: Original producer observation only
acceptedBoundaries.evidence: Fixed actual Auto exports nativeReviewReceipt and planQuestion are called with current inputs. No registration/apply/prepare/build/compile function is invoked. Native null and plan APPLY are recorded without granting approval or executing a plan.

acceptedBoundaries.name: Fail closed result contract
acceptedBoundaries.evidence: Unknown Native result shapes, unknown plan statuses, unmatched UID/source/ordinal, unrecognized reason text or any call exception produce failure. Free text errors are hashed; no source, answer, solution, rationale or final object is serialized.

acceptedBoundaries.name: Bounded metadata transport
acceptedBoundaries.evidence: Report capped at512KiB with exact raw/Git/size framing; only locator/status/field-name metadata and whole hashes are emitted. Output is outside actual input checkout.

acceptedBoundaries.name: Input preservation
acceptedBoundaries.evidence: Normal completion verifies input object whole hashes, all watched disk input pins and HEAD/worktree equality. Early input/call failure is a failed observation, not a completed unchanged assertion.

acceptedBoundaries.name: Workflow permissions
acceptedBoundaries.evidence: Exact repository and one closed push branch; contents:read; persist-credentials:false; fixed actual snapshot; no remote writes.

limitations.inputUnchangedOnEarlyAbort: Not independently observed; use actual success/failure fields, not the declarative write-count alone.

nextAction: Root may publish the exact read-only probe and evaluate actual metadata. Do not treat Native=null, APPLY or observer completion as a new approval or registration.
